title: The Fire Nation Attacks
description: The hundred-year war ignites in earnest. Everyone knows to buy the war machine — the war has other ideas.

companies.name: Sozin Steelworks
companies.description: Forges tank hulls and siege engines at one vast foundry ringing the capital; every smelter is worked by firebenders.

companies.name: Caldera Coalworks
companies.description: Mines coal in mountain seams far from the capital; fuels Fire Navy steamships and factory boilers. Machines, not benders.

companies.name: Talon Post
companies.description: Trained messenger hawks carry sealed scrolls between every great city — no road or ship involved.

companies.name: South Seas Shipping
companies.description: Water Tribe fleet freighting dried fish, whale oil and sea prunes across the southern ocean; every route a sea lane.

companies.name: Serpent's Pass Ferries
companies.description: Runs the lake ferries to Ba Sing Se — the only paid passage into the walled capital.

companies.name: Omashu Chute & Parcel
companies.description: Delivers mail down the earthbent stone chutes of the mountain city Omashu; the whole network sits inside its walls.

companies.name: Jasmine Dragon Tea Houses
companies.description: Tea houses in Ba Sing Se's upper ring, run by a retired general; nobles queue daily for a table.

companies.name: Badgermole Quarries
companies.description: Earthbender-run granite quarries; holds the standing contract to maintain Ba Sing Se's outer and inner walls.

companies.name: Yu Dao Blasting Jelly
companies.description: Cooks blasting jelly in a colonial river town; sold by the barrel to mining camps and the sappers of both armies.

companies.name: Cabbage Corp
companies.description: Cabbage carts in market squares across the Earth Kingdom; the proprietor rebuilds the flagship cart after every disaster.

companies.name: Kyoshi Island Charters
companies.description: Pleasure junks and elephant-koi tours off Kyoshi Island, neutral in every war since its founding.

companies.name: White Lotus Imports
companies.description: Antique pai sho sets and curios, dealt through old shopkeepers' back rooms in every great city; in person, never by post.
